Published: 20:42 EST, 14 November 2026 | Updated: 21:42 EST, 14 November 2026.

A dismayed mother and father spoke out after their 'elite' athlete twin sons were arrested by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) as they returned to their Alabama college.

Wallace State Community College soccer players Luis and Carlos Orta Santoro, 19, were taken into ICE custody after a traffic stop on November 4 while on their way to campus, the Atlanta Journal-Constitution reported.

The Venezuelan twins were returning from visiting their parents, Carlos Enrique Orta and Reyna Santoro de Orta, in Georgia when they were arrested by a Lincoln Police Department officer during a traffic stop in east-central Alabama.

The brothers graduated from Lawrenceville's Archer High School after a successful varsity soccer career that included a first ever region title for the school.

'This is the house of two elite soccer players,' Carlos Enrique Orta, their father, told the outlet.

Luis and Carlos are asylum seekers who applied for protections after legally entering the US on a tourist visa, like their parents.

That visa expired and the twins were granted US work permits and Georgia driver's licenses, according to the outlet.

A spokesperson for the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), which oversees ICE, told the Daily Mail on Saturday that the brothers had legally entered the US with permission to stay on a temporary basis on June 21, 2022, but then 'illegally overstayed in defiance of our laws.'.

Twin brothers and soccer players Luis and Carlos Orta Santoro, both 19, were taken into ICE custody on November 5 after being arrested the previous day.

Luis and Carlos were region title-winning soccer players for Archer High School in Lawrenceville, Georgia.

The brothers were arrested as they returned from visiting their parents, Carlos Enrique Orta and Reyna Santoro de Orta (both left).

It has been revealed that the DHS spokesperson told the Daily Mail: 'All their claims will be heard by an immigration judge, and they will receive due process. This administration will not ignore the rule of law.'.

'To be clear, pending applications do NOT confer legal status,' the statement continued.

Carlos was named the offensive player of the year and Luis the midfield player of the year by their high school this year.

They had received soccer scholarships to attend Wallace State, which they began doing this fall, but now face deportation to Venezuela.

'It's been hell,' Santoro de Orta, their mother, told the outlet.

She added that she supported ICE 'taking away the criminals' but stated her children did not fit that description.

A final decision on the brothers' asylum case is still pending as they remain in custody.

The concerned mother claimed police mentioned the twins' car had failed to come to a complete stop at a stop sign.

The brothers were arrested by a Lincoln Police Department officer as they were returning to Wallace State Community College, where they have soccer scholarships.

According to recent reports, the family applied for asylum protections after legally entering the country on a tourist visa. The DHS remarked the brothers 'illegally overstayed in defiance of our laws'.

The Lincoln Police Department signed a partnership agreement with ICE in July.

ICE said the program allows trained local officers to exercise limited immigration authority during routine police work under federal supervision, according to the Cullman Tribune.

Luis and Carlos were booked into the Talladega County Jail on November 4 and transferred to ICE custody the following day.

Their father, Orta, described how the family was grappling with guilt as they shared what happened to their children.

Sources indicate that 'If anyone is at fault, it's me. It's us,' Orta told the outlet. 'Because I insist and I will continue to insist that Carlos and Luis came here because of a decision we made.'.

He added: 'Carlos and Luis stayed here because of a decision from mom and dad. Carlos and Luis are here because of us.'.

The Santoro twins were taken to the Pine Prairie ICE Processing Center in southern Louisiana after their arrest, WABE reported.

The brothers have been taken to the the Pine Prairie ICE Processing Center in southern Louisiana.

The Lincoln Police Department signed an partnership agreement with ICE in July. A department officer arrested the brothers.

A friend of the twins, Nicolas Azcarate Florez, remarked he had spoken to them multiple times since they were taken into custody.

'They've been saying that they've been moved five times, so it has been difficult for them,' Azcarate Florez told the outlet.

Azcarate Florez stated the brothers were 'players that you could just give the ball to, and you would know that they would do something good with it.'.

'If we needed them, we would know that they would be there to help us out of a sticky situation,' he added.

The brothers were taken into custody on the same week that the Republican Party faced a historic blue wave in the midterm elections that was seen as a rebuke of the GOP's immigration policy.

One of President Donald Trump's first moves afterwards was to name Stephen Miller as the newly introduced White House chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles.

Miller, one of Trump's most loyal and longest-serving advisers going back to his first administration, is known for his hardline views on immigration.

Critics have cited Miller as the architect of some of Trump's most divisive policies, including separating migrant families during deportations in the President's first term.

In an editorial for MilanNews today, Pietro Mazzara looked at the current squad and what Cardinale plans to do.

It has been revealed that “AC Milan’s transfer market is poised for significant events because Gerry Cardinale has no intention of stopping. His comments in recent days, both public and private, are a clear statement of what the AC Milan owner intends to do to bring AC Milan back to the top.

Industry observers note that “Whether he succeeds or not will only be determined by time and the type of decisions he makes, but he certainly has the desire, vision, and financial resources. One can expect anything from someone who beat out Netflix for the Warner Bros. acquisition.

“Among the many things he has learned is that the climate of mediocrity surrounding results has undermined the mentality of a club and an environment that, instead, must strive to always be at the top.

“But returning to those levels requires several factors: a clear decision-making structure (which will be finalised by Markus Krösche, who will always report to Cardinale, who will always have the final say and be involved in negotiations), strong players in the squad, a political presence in the halls of power, a connection with the fans, and credibility.

Recent findings suggest that “What may seem like slogans in themselves are actually manifestos that one can legitimately believe or not. The only way to evaluate Cardinale’s work is to observe how he operates and then draw conclusions.

“He’s fired up, and between January and next summer there will be some serious transfer campaigns. The reason is simple: there’s a need to significantly raise the squad’s level, creating a core of 16-18 players of a certain caliber who can be joined by young players to develop and develop.

“This is why Milan will be looking for not only technically strong players, but also leaders who can complement those already in the Milan core group.

In a recent development, “It’s crucial to raise the team’s personality, including strong personalities who can provide a different kind of motivation during the day-to-day at Milanello. These players, inevitably, cost money, but Cardinale doesn’t want to set limits.

“This doesn’t mean Milan will sign a player worth one hundred million euros, but it does mean they can continue along the operational path laid out by Diego Moreira. All of this is in concert and in line with Ruben Amorim, who is fiercely defended by the AC Milan owner and with whom he intends to begin a long-term relationship.

“And the vision is to acquire the Van Dijks in the pre-prime phase rather than signing them at 35 (assuming, for the sake of argument, that I’d sign someone like that now).

“Meanwhile, discussions are ongoing to finalise the renewal of Adrien Rabiot and Alphadjo Cisse.”.

Nella sua intervista a Cronache di Spogliatoio, Antonio Conte ha raccontato un interessante aneddoto risalente ai primi tempi in cui era stato nominato allenatore della Juve: “Ero appena arrivato alla Juventus e stavamo facendo il ritiro a Bardonecchia. Il mercoledì avevamo giocato contro una squadra composta, come si dice scherzosamente, da una rappresentativa di boscaioli: eravamo andati subito in svantaggio e avevamo poi vinto con un risultato molto largo, credo 18-1 o 20-1. La domenica avevo organizzato un'altra partita contro la stessa squadra. Dopo quella gara avevo dato due giorni liberi ai giocatori, perché poi ci saremmo ritrovati in aeroporto per partire per gli Stati Uniti e proseguire il ritiro. Anche quella volta partiamo e prendiamo subito gol. Gigi era in porta nel primo tempo. All'intervallo cambio tutta la squadra, compreso lui, e faccio entrare Marco Storari. La partita finisce nuovamente con un risultato molto largo, intorno al 20-1. Una volta può capitare una distrazione, ma ripetere lo stesso errore nella seconda partita non andava bene. Così, alla fine, dico al team manager: «Fermati un attimo, prima di andare via. Devo parlare alla squadra».

Recent findings suggest that lo vedo agitato e gli chiedo che cosa stia succedendo. Mi risponde: «Nel primo tempo Buffon è andato via. Non sapeva che dovesse rimanere fino alla fine». Gli domando dove sia e lui mi dice che è già arrivato a Torino. A quel punto gli chiedo di chiamare Gigi e dirgli di tornare indietro, perché avevo bisogno di parlare alla squadra e volevo che ci fosse anche lui. Buffon torna, si scusa e io gli dico che non deve scusarsi: non sapeva che dovesse rimanere, ma per me era importante che fosse presente. Era uno dei capitani, insieme ad Alessandro Del Piero, e uno dei giocatori più rappresentativi del gruppo. A quel punto faccio la ramanzina a tutti: «Fatemi capire, giochiamo contro questa squadra e prendiamo gol dopo pochi secondi per la seconda volta? Una distrazione può capitare, ma non possiamo ripetere lo stesso errore».

In a recent development, faccio il mio piccolo shampoo alla squadra e poi li lascio liberi. Tutti sapevano che Gigi era già partito per Torino, ma che aveva dovuto fare inversione ed era tornato perché glielo avevo chiesto. Per me sarebbe stato molto più semplice fare la ramanzina senza Buffon. Ma non sarebbe stata la stessa cosa. Gigi aveva commesso un errore senza saperlo, ma avrebbe dovuto informarsi. E il gruppo ha capito che quella regola valeva per tutti: l'aveva infranta Buffon, non un ragazzo della Primavera. Questo, a mio avviso, è il modo giusto per far passare un messaggio”.

Raffaele De Leonardis: “La Zes, il laghetto, le fake news: tutti i retroscena della trattativa con De Laurentiis per il centro sportivo a Qualiano”

💡 Key Takeaways
  • A Radio Napoli Centrale, nel corso di Un Calcio alla Radio è intervenuto Raffaele De Leonardis (sindaco di Qualiano): “Quali sono i progetti da affiancare al centro sportivo del Napoli?
  • Quanto mi hanno dato fastidio le fake news attorno a questo?
  • In a recent development, I Am Naples Testata Giornalistica - aut.

A Radio Napoli Centrale, nel corso di Un Calcio alla Radio è intervenuto Raffaele De Leonardis (sindaco di Qualiano): “Quali sono i progetti da affiancare al centro sportivo del Napoli? Dopo la firma ho già pensato a cosa fare attorno alla zona. Quella sarà una cittadella dello sport, perché affianco ai terreni dove sorgerà il centro sportivo c’è uno stadio, ci sono campi da tennis e abbiamo in animo un palazzetto dello sport e una piscina. Oggi c’è la parte più difficile, quella della burocrazia e infrastrutture. In poco tempo che mi rimane come sindaco mi metterò a disposizione. Quante volte è saltata la trattativa con il Napoli e perché? La prima volta è saltata per il prezzo d’acquisto. Il Presidente De Laurentiis doveva valutare l’investimento. I primi terreni con destinazione urbanistica si parlava di 100 euro a metro quadro. Non c’era bisogno della Zes. Servivano 20 milioni di euro. Non era nelle disponibilità e intenzioni della società. Perché poi bisognava costruire il centro. E comparando con il Viola Park, finanziato dal 20% del Coni, ci fu un primo stop. Successivamente, la Zes paventava di superare vincoli urbanistici, allora si è cominciato a parlare di terreni agricoli. E quindi si è riallacciato il rapporto perché c’erano terreni che rientravano nei desideri della SSC Napoli. C’è stata una visita, sotto la pioggia, il famoso 30 marzo dell’anno dello Scudetto. Il Presidente del Napoli mi invitò allo stadio Maradona, vidi Massimo Boldi, c’era Serena Brancale, c’era De Martino. Quanti vaffa mi sono preso dal Presidente? Abbastanza (sorride ndr). Nell’ultima riunione c’era Chiavelli, c’erano Testa, Discepolo, c’era anche Edo e lì ho capito che forse c’eravamo. Se De Laurentiis si è messo in auto per vedere le distanze dalle stazioni ai terreni? Sì, la prima volta che venne a visitare i terreni prima di Napoli-Milan fece questo percorso in auto. Il Presidente De Laurentiis chiedeva quanto distasse dalla stazione di Afragola, ed erano circa 20 minuti, dalla stazione di Ponte Riccio al centro sono 10 minuti a piedi e da Varcaturo o zone residenziali dei giocatori sono 8 minuti di auto e dallo stadio sono 20 minuti con la tangenziale. Dall’aeroporto ancora meno, 12-13 minuti. De Laurentiis percepiva che la posizione era buona. Fece però un passo indietro in merito alla storia dei rifiuti tossici, si era spaventato, ma non era vero.

Quanto mi hanno dato fastidio le fake news attorno a questo? No, sono il Sindaco di Qualiano, ne sento tante. Però penso che ci sono solo pensieri in negativo. Ma pensiamo anche in positivo. Tutte queste problematiche potrebbero nascere, magari con la Zes. Ma noi che ci guadagniamo? Niente! C’è uno strumento di legge, sono stati fatti i migliori investimenti, noi stiamo sperando che non venga approvato? De Laurentiis ha firmato un atto notarile, un preliminare condizionato e se arriva l’autorizzazione, si trasforma automaticamente in definitivo. Lui che se ne fa di un terreno agricolo!? La Zes ha sette linee guida. Una delle linee riguarda l’attività produttiva per quanto riguarda turismo e sport. Noi non ci opporremo, perché sarebbe da folli. Chiederemo le infrastrutture che dovranno essere realizzate e aiuteremo il Napoli a realizzarle. Noi stiamo rispettando la legge. Se il prof Discepolo presenta il progetto definitivo in 10-15 giorni e partono i 90 giorni della Zes, seguiremo il countdown. Sentivo parlare di un’autorizzazione preliminare per il muro di cinta, con autorizzazione dei proprietari. Se ci sarà un laghetto? Non so se è un vezzo, ma servirà per irrigare i campi. Sarà a mo’ di cisterna. Se ci saranno hotel? Ci saranno sicuramente le stanze per i giocatori. De Laurentiis tiene tanto alla cantera, penso che farà anche un convitto per i giovani”.

  • The decompression sickness caused by emerging from a League One fixture for two sides who should be much higher must be severe.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Published: 08:28 EST, 15 November 2026 | Updated: 10:25 EST, 15 November 2026.

Hamilton Academical 1 Ross County 2.

The depth of the descent of Hamilton Accies and Ross County would make it understandable if tickets for a fixture between the two carried warning about the bends when leaving Newly introduced Douglas Park.

The decompression sickness caused by emerging from a League One fixture for two sides who should be much higher must be severe. There may, however, be a positive prognosis.

Accies, despite their defeat, are whispering about stability, even though ‘legacy debt’ has to be faced, perhaps contested.

County, meanwhile, will not say it even in a whisper but Saturday’s victory takes them eight points clear at the top and heavily fancied for the title. The Staggies have one set of hooves in the Championship.

Scottish football, of course, does not restrict itself to the cliched fare of top of the table clashes so Newly introduced Douglas Park hosted a striker who is 39 later this month, a winger who was once a Scottish international, and a gentleman in the stands who once played against George Best. And a Ross County fan who regularly travels up from North Wales.

These exotic avenues demand to be explored but perennial questions about the financial health of the Accies had to be asked, too, after reports this week stating that hospitality packages at the club were being suspended.

An Accies fan feels the pain of defeat during Saturday's home loss to Ross County.

Allan Currie, chairman, answered them over a half-time pie.

Sources indicate that ‘We have come on in leaps and bounds but every week seems to throw up different challenges,’ he mentioned. ‘We have a level of debt that we have inherited and we are working with the creditors to try to navigate our way through that.’.

Matters on the field are positive, despite Saturday’s defeat.

According to recent reports, ‘The guys on the pitch, manager, and his staff have been unbelievable. Surviving in this league last season was phenomenal given what they were going through but it couldn’t be better now,’ he said. ‘Off the pitch, we are fighting with the different challenges we have. We are in a much better place even if we are not out the woods yet.’.

Asked what the level of pressure on him, he stated: ‘I am the guy on the ground but Rob Edwards is carrying out negotiations.’.

Edwards, through his Morley Group, took over the club earlier this year but has been sideswiped by a number of claims for payment. However, Currie has faith in the owner.

‘Without him, the club would not survive. Rob should take all the credit,’ he said.

Asked what the short-term aims for the club were, Currie replied with a smile: ‘A goal in the second half would be good.’ A goal was scored but not for the Accies.

But the club remain in second place and the play-offs seem a more than reasonable prospect.

Ross County goalscorer Kieran Phillips battles with Hamilton's Kai Smutek.

Recent findings suggest that with 10 minutes to go, Hamilton brought on their latest signing. Barrie McKay, who has played for Scotland and scored for Rangers in a Scottish Cup semi-final against Celtic. His considerable achievements, though, paled in comparison to the subject of a casual conversation in the bar before the match.

‘I played against George Best,’ said Alan McDougall, with an air so off-hand one could have believed he was merely ordering another pint.

In a recent development, ‘Yes, I played 200 games for the Accies. Davie McParland brought me here as a 21-year-old and I played for about six years. I went to Stranraer for a year and then went down south. I played against Best with the Accies.’.

The Northern Irish genius played for Hibernian in 1979-80. ‘He was well past his best and that was sad,’ said McDougall. Best’s addiction to alcohol had taken a severe toll.

‘I came back to watch games five or six years ago,’ remarked McDougall. ‘When the club went to Clyde, it destroyed me. What is fantastic is that the people that are now in control seem to be turning it around.’.

Industry observers note that there was a mood of cautious optimism from other fans. ‘I have been a fan since forever, well the 1980s at least,’ remarked Gavin Fullarton. ‘I have seen this team in every division. I have seen them in the downs and downs. But I think we are going in the right direction. So far.’.

Industry observers note that he added: ‘The newly introduced guys seem to know what they are doing. They are communicative.’.

There were 1,216 fans in the ground on Saturday with 300 stalwarts travelling down from the north. Colin Richardson, an Accies supporter, was asked why so many had stuck by the club.

Recent findings suggest that ‘It’s about loyalty,’ he noted. ‘You can’t pick and choose when you support your team. At the moment it is all about small steps. It has to be about stability.’.

According to recent reports, A Ross County fan had travelled up from North Wales. The journey to Scotland is a familiar one for Ian Ellson. ‘I have been all over Scotland to watch Ross County,’ he mentioned. ‘Twenty years ago I visited Ross County and I was spoiled rotten. I decided to follow them.’.

It has been revealed that A social worker, he averages one visit a month. ‘I live and breathe Ross County,’ he mentioned. ‘This season we are going up.’.

Welsh Staggies fan Ian Elson and Englishman Ray Griffiths travelled far for Saturday's game.

It has been revealed that brian Graham would not be so bullish. He is 39 this month and has learned enough about football to know that predictions are made only to make the speaker seem foolish down the line.

He was, though, expansive about what is happening at County. He joined the club for the second time in the summer after Stuart Kettlewell, the manager, convinced him of the ambitions in Dingwall.

‘This is a club where I have had success before so I know how good a club it can be,’ he said. ‘It’s not been great for a couple of seasons but in the summer the manager set out his stall very early. It was about leaving egos at the door, building a togetherness and having a change of culture at the club. I think you are seeing that now.’.

The early signs were good for the striker who dropped down from Falkirk in the Premiership to play in Dingwall.

‘We had good pre-season performances against Aberdeen and Dundee and that was a solid building block,’ he noted.

Brian Graham celebrates after scoring his 21st goal of the season for County.

Industry observers note that graham converted a first-half penalty to reach a tally of 21 goals this season and the Christmas trees are not up yet. ‘I get a lot of plaudits for scoring goals but others in the team are scoring a lot too,’ he stated. ‘We are scoring team goals.’.

Has he set a target for the season? ‘When I came back I knew I had to score 13 to reach 50 goals for the club in two spells,’ he remarked. ‘I always set down targets in a wee black book but now I might need to readjust that.’.

Sources indicate that it was a night of adjustment for Darian MacKinnon. He had set a victory target but was condemned to accept defeat. He would not concede the league race was over. ‘We have to play them twice,’ he remarked.

He added ‘We are going in the right direction. The owners have put money in and they have backed us.’.

Asked to pinpoint a factor that has contributed to the team sitting second, he noted: ‘The most positive thing for me this season is that this is now a good place to come into your work after the last three or four seasons. We are all actually enjoying coming to our work.’.

According to recent reports, there is work to be done on and off the pitch but the Accies are surviving. And that is the biggest result.

It seems Ruben Loftus-Cheek could leave AC Milan in January, with the club hoping to invest heavily in the squad and raise the base level.

Loftus-Cheek’s Milan career is a frustrating one. He started off with a fantastic season in Serie A, but the same injury issues that had haunted him in England were present. Unfortunately, that’s the tale of his career in Italy, too.

His talent is very clearly there, but we’ve never had too much of a chance to see it on a consistent basis. It’s an unfortunate reality and this is likely to be the final full year of it.

Industry observers note that according to Gazzetta dello Sport, as Francesco Nasato relays on X, the Rossoneri could part ways with Loftus-Cheek in the new year. There are right now no renewal talks happening, so he’ll be able to leave as a free agent in the summer.

Pre-contract discussions can begin, alternatively, someone may be a small fee to bring him to the club six months early. Either way, it seems likely that he leaves the Diavolo in 2027.

Sources indicate that he’s right now sidelined, as the report continues, and hopes to return in late November if not early December, so time is running out for him to earn a renewal with the club. At this stage, though, it’s probably too high a mountain to climb.

An unfortunate position for everyone to be in, considering how impressive his first season was.

💡 Key Takeaways

  • Sources indicate that ma può, dopo undici partite, avere già una valutazione da 35 o 40 milioni di euro?
  • Per capire il possibile prezzo di Varela bisogna separare due cose: le qualità individuali del centravanti e quelle che il gioco di Juric può amplificare.

Nove gol in dieci partite giocate sono certamente un dato. Gustavo Varela è senza ombra di dubbio un giocatore che sta straordinariamente stupendo al suo anno di debutto in Serie A. Ma è tutto 'vero'? E' tutto oro quel che luccica? C'è un assunto da cui partire: il Monza ha trovato il giocatore perfetto per il proprio allenatore, Ivan Juric. E questo è certamente un colpo non da poco, perché la società brianzola, pur nelle mille difficoltà, invischiata nella lotta per non retrocedere, è stata capace di individuare un ragazzo poco noto e conosciuto e capire che le sue qualità e doti erano funzionali per il tecnico. Un po' quello che dovrebbe essere l'obiettivo primario e principale per ogni direttore sportivo.

Sources indicate that ma può, dopo undici partite, avere già una valutazione da 35 o 40 milioni di euro? Il problema non è che Varela valga o non valga 40 milioni. Il problema è che, dopo così poche gare, qualcuno potrebbe essere chiamato a pagare oggi il calciatore che forse diventerà domani. E lo scotto in molti l'hanno già pagato, abbagliati dal clamore mediatico, da quel che appare, viene percepito, ma in fondo non è davvero. Krzysztof Piatek fece 13 gol in 17 partite in Serie A col Genoa, il Milan spese per lui 38 milioni di euro ma venne di lì a non molto ceduto all'Herta Berlino, nonostante 9 reti nei primi sei mesi. Una grande fiammata per un'illusione (straordinaria) collettiva che non ebbe però seguito e continuità. E figuriamoci Juan Manuel Iturbe, che Walter Sabatini strappò alla Juventus: lo prese la Roma, dopo 8 gol in 33 partite con l'Hellas Verona. Segnò poco, giocò male, l'illusione lì fu quella di aver trovato il nuovo genio del calcio italiano. E anche Patrik Schick, che poi in Germania s'è riconfermato grande al Bayer Leverkusen. Lo prese la Roma, dopo un inizio meraviglioso con la Sampdoria. Lì sì che il talento è vero e con continuità, la Roma non seppe individuarne però la funzionalità (al netto di infortuni e adattamento). Altri esempi? Jackson Martinez, strapagato dall'Atletico Madrid dopo le stagioni al Porto. Andy Carroll, fece 11 reti in 18 gare da titolare in Premier League e al Liverpool lo ricordano più per il codino che per i milioni spesi. Timo Werner, 28 reti in Bundesliga, è arrivato il nuovo panzer, macché, il Chelsea spese una fortuna e mai s'è ripetuto. E poi via, da Renato Sanches a Wilfried Bony, quanti sogni spezzati e milioni gonfiati dall'illusione e dall'entusiasmo.

Per capire il possibile prezzo di Varela bisogna separare due cose: le qualità individuali del centravanti e quelle che il gioco di Juric può amplificare. E' il vecchio assunto e teorema del 'con Gian Piero Gasperini all'Atalanta tanti facevano bene e altrove no'. Sapete qual era il segreto? Le scelte della famiglia Percassi e delle dirigenze. La parola 'funzionalità'. Creare un vestito adatto al proprio allenatore, i giocatori giusti al netto di nomi e risonanza mediatica. Varela è un finalizzatore superiore alla media? Oppure sta vivendo un periodo di conversione straordinario? Riuscirebbe a produrre le stesse occasioni in una squadra di vertice? Una major spesso affronta avversari chiusi, che concedono meno profondità. Altra tematica: può fare reparto da solo? Un conto è essere devastante quando il sistema crea spazi e accompagna l'attacco; un altro è diventare il riferimento di una squadra che deve costruire contro una difesa schierata.

Il Monza potrebbe avere trovato in Varela il centravanti ideale per il calcio di Ivan Juric. Ma una cosa è essere il terminale offensivo perfetto di un sistema che esalta verticalità, aggressività e transizioni; un'altra è dimostrare di poter essere il centravanti di una grande squadra, chiamata spesso a scardinare difese schierate. Il mercato rischia di pagare oggi entrambe le versioni, senza sapere ancora quale delle due abbia davvero davanti. In una moda mica solo italiana, beninteso, ma nella quale ci tuffiamo sempre a caso fitto...

After a humiliating defeat by Grimsby Town in their previous League Cup campaign, Manchester United found a different way to exit the competition this time around. The jeers heard at the full-time whistle after throwing away a two-goal lead pointed to more worrying times a year on from Blundell Park.

For the first time in half a century, United lost a game at Old Trafford having led 2-0, highlighting the defensive problems Michael Carrick needs to solve after turning results around last season.

“What the f---ing hell was that?” shouted the home fans, in a chant that may have been aimed at the referee but equally applied to United’s players, who led through Shea Lacey and Mason Mount’s early goals.

Brighton cut through Carrick’s defence several times before staging their comeback with goals from Charalampos Kostoulas, Pascal Gross and Maxim De Cuyper. Carrick and his analysts will rewatch the footage of all three goals in horror at how they conceded.

Erik ten Hag used the domestic cups to taste success while struggling in the Premier League, but one of those opportunities is now lost to Carrick, who must be careful not to spiral from a poor start to the campaign into crisis. Sunday’s trip to Fulham before the international break now feels like a big game for United and Carrick.

“We’ve gone out of the cup and the feeling around the place feels bigger than that,” Carrick mentioned. “I’ll be honest about that, that’s how it feels, but it doesn’t have to be like that. If we win football matches again, it can go in a different direction.

According to recent reports, “We have a massive game on Sunday that we have to prepare for. We’re out of this competition and we have to go back to winning football matches.

According to recent reports, “It doesn’t feel good at the moment. It doesn’t feel good. We have to go back to winning football matches. We want to win and want to win rapidly. The next game is Sunday. That’s all I’m thinking about right now.”.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By Ben Knapton | 19 Nov 2026 09:14, Last updated: 20 Nov 2026 11:50.

A modern Premier League rivalry will be renewed on Saturday evening, when champions Arsenal make the long trek north to battle Newcastle United following the international break.

The Gunners entered the hiatus on the back of a fifth straight win, edging out Hull City 1-0, while Matthias Jaissle's inconsistent troops settled for a 1-1 draw at Fulham.

The Hull low block momentarily appeared capable of withstanding all of Arsenal's huffing and puffing two weekends ago, but the holders were belatedly rewarded for their endeavours when Martin Odegaard tucked home a second-half rebound.

Arsenal's task would have been easier had they been awarded a first-half penalty for Nobel Mendy's shirt pull on an offside Kai Havertz - the Premier League's Key Match Incidents panel has now ruled that the failure to award a spot kick was incorrect - but as champions do, they found a way to triumph while not at their finest.

Courtesy of their 34th 1-0 Premier League win under Mikel Arteta - the most by any coach since he took charge in December 2019 - and Manchester City's latest setback at Nottingham Forest, Arsenal opened up a five-point advantage at the top of the Premier League table before international football intervened.

Furthermore, the Gunners' total of 27 points from their opening 10 games of a Premier League season can only be bested by the 28 accrued by Chelsea in 2005-06, Manchester City in 2011-12, Man City again in 2017-18 and Liverpool in 2019-20; each of those teams went on to finish first.

While Arsenal's only loss of the top-flight campaign so far came away to Brighton & Hove Albion, they have won each of their other four road trips without conceding and have also kept four straight clean sheets altogether in the Premier League; not since January 2006 have they registered five straight shut-outs in the division.

Arsenal's four clean sheets in their last four Premier League games is more than Newcastle have managed across all competitions all season, Jaissle's men only keeping the opposition at bay three times and failing to do so at Craven Cottage on November 7.

A Jacob Murphy stunner preceded a slightly fortuitous Rodrigo Muniz equaliser for Fulham, extending Newcastle's winless run to three games in all tournaments and leaving them languishing in the bottom half.

Nevertheless, Jaissle labelled a point in London a "step in the right direction" after his side's harrowing home loss to Everton, as Murphy's fine left-footed strike continued the Magpies' sequence of scoring in every away game in 2026-27.

However, after scoring at least twice in each of their first four matches at St James' Park this season, Newcastle have now failed to net in each of their last two, going down 1-0 to Aston Villa and Everton in successive clashes.

The hosts were also subjected to an agonising one-goal loss in this fixture last term, as Gabriel Magalhaes completed a 2-1 Arsenal comeback win, ending the Gunners' three-match losing run in front of the St James' Park faithful.

Newcastle United Premier League form:.

Newcastle United form (all competitions):.

Arsenal form (all competitions):.

Arsenal players did not drop like flies over the international break, contrary to some previous pauses, but the Gunners will be without Martin Zubimendi after the midfielder hurt his hamstring in Spain's 3-2 loss to England.

The second-string lynchpin joins Bukayo Saka (quad) and the suspended Max Dowman on the Arsenal sidelines, but Arteta will otherwise have an identical squad to the one that got the better of Hull.

Expect Bruno Guimaraes to appear from the off against his former employers, while Havertz should hold off the threat of Viktor Gyokeres despite the latter extending an all-time Nations League record in November.

On Newcastle's end, Jacob Ramsey returns from a one-match ban after his sending-off against Everton, while Nico Gonzalez and Joe Willock are also expected to be fine despite suffering from illness earlier in the week.

Joelinton's thigh injury will likely keep him out of this one, though, while backup goalkeeper Ewen Jaouen will be out for at least another few weeks with a hamstring problem of his own.

Ex-Arsenal target Matias Fernandez-Pardo has also returned from a troublesome illness of his own, and the 21-year-old may be given a shot over the underwhelming Yoane Wissa here.

Newcastle United possible starting lineup:.

Hornicek; Dedic, Thiaw, Burn, Hall; Steur, Gonzalez; Murphy, Fernandez-Pardo, Barnes; Osula.

Arsenal possible starting lineup:.

Raya; Timber, Konsa, Gabriel, Calafiori; Guimaraes, Rice; Madueke, Odegaard, Tzolis; Havertz.

While the break came at a better time for Newcastle than Arsenal, an increasingly familiar fate is set to befall the Magpies at St James' Park.

The champions' defensive might is showing no sign of wavering, nor is their ability to grind out victories in challenging circumstances, so we anticipate another 1-0 to the Arsenal.

Buchanan gave an early ball away to allow Shaw to race through towards the Chelsea goal, and a few minutes later was again outmuscled and outpaced by the Jamaican striker, although City failed to capitalise on both occasions.

The 31-year-old Canada international looked devastated when her number flashed up on the board after just 12 minutes and reluctantly welcomed a hug from her manager as she headed straight for the tunnel.

  • The Italian is under growing pressure after a turbulent November window.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By Ben Knapton | 19 Nov 2026 09:18.

Carlo Ancelotti is likely to remain Brazil head coach until at least the 2028 Copa America, regardless of Pep Guardiola's availability, according to South American football expert Tim Vickery.

The Italian is under growing pressure after a turbulent November window. He was sent off during Saturday's 3-2 friendly defeat to Japan, prompting Brazil great Romario to publicly demand his exit, before watching from the stands as his side thrashed Singapore 7-0 on Tuesday.

That followed a hugely disappointing World Cup, in which Brazil were knocked out in the last 16 by Norway, their earliest exit from the tournament since 1990.

Speaking exclusively to Sports Mole, Vickery admitted that Ancelotti's reign has fallen well short of expectations, but believes his contract, which runs until 2030, is keeping him in the job.

"If this was a run-of-the-mill Brazil coach, he could well already be receiving his marching orders, because there's no doubt about it: his time with Brazil has proved a massive disappointment so far," Vickery stated.

"Through the World Cup it was acceptable and nothing more until, by his own confession, he made a very poor substitution against Norway and lost control of that game.

"Coming off an extremely disappointing World Cup, Brazilians want to win. They're not that patient, and they're not that interested in long-term tests.

"The key issue is one he hasn't solved: how do you reconcile a team with two wingers with the midfield resources Brazil have, and still remain compact and defensively solid?".

According to recent reports, guardiola has been out of work since leaving Manchester City at the end of 2025-26, and he has history with the Selecao. In late 2012, while on sabbatical in Latest York, he let it be known that coaching Brazil was the one job that could tempt him back, only for the CBF to rush through the appointment of Luiz Felipe Scolari.

Vickery believes Brazil would now be more open to Guardiola, but stressed that no change is imminent, with Ancelotti's next opportunity to impress not coming until the end of March.

Industry observers note that "As a club coach, if things aren't going well, you try something on Wednesday and something else at the weekend. You can't do that as a national team coach," Vickery explained.

"The pressure is on him to come up with a coherent idea of a side, and if that means packing the midfield and giving up one of his wingers, that's the way he's going to have to go.

"The next international window is very key for him to win his credibility back, but I suspect at least until the Copa America of 2028, Carlo Ancelotti will be Brazil coach.".

Guardiola has also been tipped to replace Mauricio Pochettino as USA manager following the latter's move to Manchester United, and Pochettino has publicly talked up the ex-Manchester City boss taking the job.

I marchigiani, però, non sono certo l'avversario più abbordabile, da neo promossi sono ora terzi. Ed ecco, proprio quest'ultimo dettaglio accomuna le due compagini: il Vicenza ha stravinto il campionato di C il 16 marzo, l'Ascoli è dovuto passare dai playoff; poi tutto è cambiato. Si vede adesso la truppa bianconera solida ed equilibrata, più vulnerabile il 3-5-2 dei biancorossi.

According to recent reports, catanzaro-Palermo: aquile a un passo dalla A nella passata stagione, siciliani che puntano dritto a quell'obiettivo da primi in classifica. La speranza, sponda giallorossa, potrebbe aumentare per il fatto che, tra le mura amiche, il gol è sempre arrivato; si dovrà però non subirne.

Empoli-Pisa: società unite sull'assurdità di un divieto di trasferta, definito mediante una nota ufficiale come "sconfitta" del calcio, ma in campo sarà battaglia, perché gli azzurri non hanno ancora trovato continuità e cambio di passo dopo l'arrivo di Andreoletti in panchina, i nerazzurri non vincono invece da quattro giornata. Latest Update: Inside Sir Alex Ferguson's inner circle of Man United legends: The player threatened 'he will end up in a ditch' by football chief, the cult-hero striker still playing at 38 and sorry Michael Carrick after his Old Trafford sacking

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 02:01 EST, 15 November 2026 | Updated: 11:52 EST, 15 November 2026.
  • It's safe to say Manchester United are going through a rough patch - and then some - at the moment, but many of their supporters would have raised a smile at one photo that surfaced earlier this month.
  • A few of the club's legends reunited to raise a glass to Sir Alex Ferguson on his 40th anniversary of being named Red Devils manager.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By LUKE AUGUSTUS, ASSISTANT SPORTS EDITOR.

Published: 02:01 EST, 15 November 2026 | Updated: 11:52 EST, 15 November 2026.

It's safe to say Manchester United are going through a rough patch - and then some - at the moment, but many of their supporters would have raised a smile at one photo that surfaced earlier this month.

A few of the club's legends reunited to raise a glass to Sir Alex Ferguson on his 40th anniversary of being named Red Devils manager.

Ferguson, who retired in 2013, won 38 major honours during a trophy-laden 26 years at Old Trafford.

And as the 84-year-old received plaudits across the footballing world, he enjoyed a celebratory intimate setting with some of his former players and actor James Nesbitt in Manchester.

Diehard United fan Nesbitt shared a group photo on Instagram, featuring Ferguson alongside Michael Carrick, Edwin van der Sar, Nemanja Vidic, Robin van Persie, Darren Fletcher, Jonny Evans, Javier Hernandez and John O'Shea.

Industry observers note that but what are those former United players up to now? Daily Mail Sport takes a look...

Actor and Man United fan James Nesbitt (centre right) posted this picture with club royalty - clockwise from front left: Jonny Evans, Darren Fletcher, Robin van Persie, Nemanja Vidic, Michael Carrick, John O'Shea, Sir Alex Ferguson, Edwin van der Sar and Javier Hernandez.

Unless you've been on another planet, then you would know everything about Carrick this past week.

The 45-year-old was sacked as United head coach on Thursday morning after a disastrous start to the season.

Carrick, who has been replaced by Mauricio Pochettino, oversaw United's worst top-flight start since Ferguson replaced Ron Atkinson 40 years ago - with one victory in 10 Premier League matches as they sit 18th.

Furthermore this season, he only won three of 15 games in all competitions.

The downturn in the Red Devils' form is bewildering considering their upturn when Carrick replaced Ruben Amorim in mid-January last season. He was handed a two-year contract in May after guiding United to a third-place finish and qualification for the Champions League, losing just two of his 17 games as head coach.

Carrick was sacked as Manchester United head coach on Thursday morning by club chiefs.

He oversaw United's worst top-flight start in Premier League history with one win in 10 games.

Like Carrick, Evans is also out of a job having been part of his backroom staff at United as first-team coach.

After retiring as a player at the end of the 2024-25 season, Evans took up the position of head of loans and pathways at Carrington but left that role last December.

Following Amorim's sacking he returned to the club to help Fletcher during his caretaker manager stint before being kept on by Carrick.

Like Carrick, Evans was relieved of his United duties having been part of his backroom team.

The sole former player still connected directly with the club, Fletcher is their Under 18s head coach. The Scot had to pause his role last season when becoming the club's first-team interim head coach following Amorim's sacking in January - drawing 2-2 with Burnley in the Premier League before overseeing their FA Cup third-round home defeat by Brighton a few days later.

Having come through the club's academy, Fletcher knows what it takes to make the grade at the club and has the likes of Kai Rooney, son of Wayne, and Jacey Carrick, son of Michael, among his squad.

And Fletcher's young charges are enjoying a strong start to the season which has included six goals in wins over Liverpool (6-3) and Burnley (6-0) at the end of last month.

Fletcher is the Red Devils' U18s head coach - nurturing the club's latest crop of rising stars.

The former Red Devils captain had ambitions to go into coaching, having done his badges, but has turned his focus on building up a real estate portfolio - telling Gary Neville on The Overlap last July that he had put £4.5million into building 76 one or two-bedroom apartments in Belgrade, Serbia.

However, this summer it was reported that Vidic had been a previous target of intimidation by a former football chief.

According to Serbian media, encrypted messages show then-Serbia's football president Slavisa Kokeza wanted people to threaten Vidic after he had publicly criticised the Serbian Football Association (FSS) over the national side's failure to qualify for the Euro 2020 tournament.

In the reported devised plot in 2020, Kokeza reportedly told one contact to make it clear to Vidic that he should 'stay away from the association or he will end up in a ditch'.

As well as that, criminals were hired to monitor the former centre-back's movements in Milan, where he lived, and fit his car with a tracking device.

Following the revelations, Vidic and his legal team filed a criminal complaint and sought an investigation into the claimed plot.

'In mid-May, OCCRP and KRIK visited my home and told me they had obtained encrypted messages from Sky ECC (a now-defunct communication encryption service which EUROPOL stated was widely used by criminals and was broken into by European police in 2021) and analysed them,' Vidic told The Athletic in July.

'The messages were remarked to have come from the then-president of the SFF in 2020. They were about me and how to stop me from talking to the media. At the time, I was commentating on the situation in Serbian football. I was living in Milan, Italy, where I stayed after finishing my career with Inter. I hadn't yet moved back to Serbia, where I am from and where I live.'.

Vidic, who has turned his focus on building up a real estate portfolio, was reportedly a previous target of intimidation by a former football chief.

Van der Sar's calm persona on the football pitch translated well into the boardroom during his near-seven-year stint at Ajax as their chief executive officer.

The former Manchester United goalkeeper joined the Dutch giants' board in 2012, becoming CEO in 2016. During his spell Ajax reached the 2017 Europa League final and 2019 Champions League semi-finals with a young exciting core of players including the likes of Frenkie de Jong and Matthijs de Ligt.

The year Van der Sar left though Ajax finished third that season to qualify for the Europa League play-offs, missing out on the Champions League for the first time since 2009.

A few weeks later in July 2023, Van der Sar was put in intensive care after suffering a brain haemorrhage while on holiday in Croatia.

Three years on since recovering, Van der Sar is enjoying being away from football for the time being telling The Overlap in February: 'Now it's almost three years ago, so I've had time to recover with no stress, no phone in my hand - just doing the stuff that I've wanted to do.

'Wake up when you want, walk the dog, go swim in the sea, go on holiday. I went to New Zealand for two months with [wife] Annemarie - nice things that I never had the chance to do before.

Industry observers note that 'I started playing at 18 or 19, finished at 40, and at 41 I became one of the directors at Ajax until 53, so I thought it was the right time to take a step back. That's taken a little bit longer than I originally thought, to be fair, but we are enjoying ourselves very much.'.

Van der Sar was Ajax CEO for seven years before stepping down from the role in 2023.

The ex-goalkeeper is now enjoying life with wife Annemarie after a brain haemorrhage in 2023.

Like Carrick, Van Persie has turned his hand to first-team management since retiring.

In a recent development, his first role was with Dutch outfit Heerenveen - signing a two-year contract with the club ahead of the 2024-25 season. However, his time there lasted just nine months as he took over the reins at Dutch giants Feyenoord.

Industry observers note that however, his time in Rotterdam lasted just 16 months there when he was sacked in June. He had guided them to second in the Eredivisie but they finished 19 points behind champions PSV Eindhoven.

In explaining his sacking, newly-appointed technical director Devy Rigaux cited the style of play as a factor.

'We conducted a thorough internal analysis,' he said. 'In this, we took into account, among other things, the development of the style of play and the declining trend in terms of points total, both in Europe and in the Eredivisie.

'The conclusion was that it is better to start the next season with a upcoming head coach.'.

The 43-year-old is awaiting a upcoming job, like Carrick.

Van Persie is at the moment without a managerial job after being sacked by Feyenoord in June.

The sole player from this list to still be playing, Hernandez made history by becoming the first-ever player signed to USL Championship outfit Atletico Dallas.

In July, the 38-year-old penned a two-year deal with an option for a third year at the expansion club which will play in the second-tier of US football, below Major League Soccer.

The Mexican striker still has a few months to wait for his debut though, with the season not beginning until March 2027.

In the meantime, he was part of the FOX broadcast team for the recent World Cup in the United States, Mexico and Canada, serving as an analyst.

Last year, Hernandez was caught up in a sexism storm, which he later apologised for, after he made a series of statements on TikTok 'promoting sexist stereotypes that are considered media violence and go against gender equality in sport'.

Hernandez stated women are 'failing' and 'eradicating masculinity'.

'Don't be afraid to be women, to allow yourselves to be led by a man,' said the former Mexico captain on social media.

His remarks sparked a backlash, which led to his apology which included him saying: 'I deeply regret any confusion or discomfort that my recent words have caused.'.

Hernandez was fined and warned about his future conduct.

Hernandez, who attended United's 4-4 draw with Aston Villa on November 8, is the only player still playing and has signed for USL Championship outfit Atletico Dallas ahead of their fresh term.

Like the majority of the names here, O'Shea's post-playing career has seen him turn to coaching with his current role being the Republic of Ireland assistant head coach.

The 45-year-old has been in this position since August 2024, staying on with his homeland's setup following the appointment of Heimir Hallgrimsson as manager.

It has been revealed that O'Shea took charge of the team for four friendly fixtures that year following Stephen Kenny's departure in November 2023. His record read one win, one draw and two defeats in that period.

The former defender will be hoping to help his country qualify for Euro 2028 which will be played on home soil across the Republic of Ireland, England, Scotland and Wales.

O'Shea is Republic of Ireland assistant head coach - a role he has held since August 2024.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

There was very much a Samba beat to this Manchester City victory – and it almost had a famous father in the crowd up dancing.

This was a night when Brazilian Allan Elias scored his first goal on an enterprising first appearance for City.

But it was another debutant who stole the show as the Carabao Cup holders sailed past Norwich City to set up a fourth-round meeting with Brighton.

Floyd Samba scored two fine goals and had a hand in another on a dream debut that had his beaming dad up off his seat and thrusting his arms in the air as if ready to party.

If the Samba surname feels familiar, that is because Floyd’s father Christopher played more than 200 games for Blackburn Rovers, Queens Park Rangers and Aston Villa.

In fact, it was very much a family affair as Floyd’s brothers Tyrone and Emerson, who are also in City’s academy and hoping one day to tread a similar path, joined in the jubilant celebrations alongside their mother, a visibly emotional Theresa.

Industry observers note that this particular evening belonged to Floyd, though. Deployed as a lone striker by Enzo Maresca, you would not have known he ordinarily plays as a midfielder such was the confidence and composure the 17-year-old oozed.

Norwich could not live with him or City for that matter as Maresca’s impressive start as manager since replacing Pep Guardiola continued apace.

Recent findings suggest that this must have been an incredibly satisfying moment for Samba Sr. He came through incredible hardship – at one stage as a teenager he was rough-sleeping – to forge an impressive career totalling more than 450 games for club and country.

According to recent reports, so to be in a position to now have three sons in City’s academy and one produce a debut like this will fill him with enormous pride. Floyd was later seen enjoying a warm embrace with his dad in the crowd, moments after being congratulated by Tyrone, a year his senior, and 12-year-old Emerson, who plays for City’s Under-13s.

“I knew there would be an opportunity to get some minutes for the first time with the first team – to get a debut like that is mind blowing,” Samba said. “I couldn’t believe it myself, but that’s just the beginning, I’ve got a massive career ahead of me. It was a great debut.”.

It has been revealed that floyd caught the eye with a fine free-kick in City’s 2-1 FA Youth Cup final victory over Manchester United last season and now he has goals for the senior side to his name. Pretty stunning they were, too.

The first was a superbly steered header past two Norwich bodies on the line from Allan’s cross and the second a lovely, nonchalantly curled finish low into the far corner.

What a moment for Floyd Samba! 😍A goal on his Man City debut for the 17-year-old, son of former Blackburn defender Chris 🩵 pic.twitter.com/VCVfX9HCNn.

According to recent reports, chris Samba has deliberately kept a low profile, keen to let his sons get on with their own careers free of distractions, but there was no chance he was going to be able to suppress his emotions in that instant. And nor should he. It was some moment for the boy and his family.

It has been revealed that as impressed as Maresca was by the goals, it will have been other elements of Samba’s game that also caught the eye. He did extremely well to hold off the attentions of Norwich’s centre-backs when receiving a pass from Ayyoub Bouaddi and then returning the ball to the Moroccan who released Rayan Cherki through to score City’s second. His movement was also sharp, at one point taking a difficult pass sweetly in an adjusted strike, only for Norwich’s Bruno Alves to come across to make a timely intervention before Samba could get his shot off.

"Was there any doubt?"Ayyoub Bouaddi with his first assist for Man City as he sets up Rayan Cherki to make it 2-0 🔵 pic.twitter.com/0gfxp5GDXy.

Sources indicate that “It was satisfying not just for the two goals but for the entire performance,” Maresca said. “He didn’t play many games as a nine but he was good. He’s young, full of energy, strong, he can finish.”.

According to recent reports, allan, a £34m summer signing from Palmeiras, will have been just as pleased with his contribution. Maresca’s fluid formation initially resembled a 3-1-5-1 with Allan effectively operating as a right wing-back but he stuck doggedly to the task before eventually getting the moment to showcase his quality, first with his cross for Samba and later with a neat solo run and finish.

Driving inside Sam Field and then cutting back inside the Norwich man before curling an inch perfect finish into the bottom corner – all of it done with his left foot – it was quite the introduction.

According to recent reports, allan on his debut! 🇧🇷Magic from the Brazilian to make it 3-0 to Man City 💥 pic.twitter.com/nw6lNqh1yL.

Hugo Viana, City’s director of football, has remarked supporters will need to be patient with Allan and that it may take the 22-year-old time to adjust to English football but this first outing will do his confidence plenty of good.

“It was crucial for him to play 90 minutes and to see a little bit the English competition that is a bit different from South America so overall was good,” Maresca said.

Cherki was the only survivor from the team that started Sunday’s victory over Manchester United but it all felt pretty seamless from City. Bouaddi, the £85m signing from Lille, was poised and graceful in midfield alongside the impressive Mateo Kovacic and Geronimo Rulli could not have asked for a much quieter debut in goal.

Industry observers note that FLOYD SAMBA again!! 🌟The 17-year-old curls one in to score his second on his Man City debut with his dad Christopher watching on in the stands 👏 pic.twitter.com/fJ5mfEWBx1.

In a recent development, nico O’Reilly looked like he had barely broken a sweat despite Norwich’s players routinely being unable to keep up with him. Norwich themselves made nine changes but the gulf in class was enormous and testament to City’s strength in depth.

The game also gave Maresca the opportunity to give run outs to two more academy graduates who played in that Youth Cup final triumph, Kaden Braithwaite and Ryan McAidoo and the latter got his own name on the scoresheet to make it 5-0.

In a recent development, all told there were seven City academy graduates on the pitch, two of them playing for Norwich. This was certainly a night to remember for the club’s youth production line.

With the dominant performance, Man City have earned themselves the privilege of hosting Brighton in the next round, who will no doubt prove a much stiffer challenge than Norwich. They become the sixth all-Premier League tie in the next round, with only Fleetwood, Bradford and Peterborough remaining from outside the top flight:.

Possession: Man City 66% vs 34% Norwich.

Touches inside opposition box: 30 vs 4.

According to recent reports, erling Haaland left out of the squad, watching from the stands, would have enjoyed that performance from Floyd Samba. Here is his second goal for you to enjoy on his debut night:.

It has been revealed that FLOYD SAMBA again!! 🌟The 17-year-old curls one in to score his second on his Man City debut with his dad Christopher watching on in the stands 👏 pic.twitter.com/fJ5mfEWBx1.

Five unanswered goals and a home-grown hero emerges for Manchester City!

In a recent development, great through ball from O’Reilly, which Lewis lets run past him for the dummy. McAidoo runs on to it on the right of the box and first-time fires it low into the far corner.

It has been a perfect night for Manchester City’s academy.

It has been revealed that well we look like we’re heading for a matching scoreline to the previous edition of the fixture. That pesky shot on target is still eluding Norwich, whereas Samba is still out there looking for his hat-trick.

Two minutes of time to be added – who will get there first?

O’Reilly sends a high, looping ball to the back post from the left side, where McAidoo rushes to meet it but can’t get over it under pressure.

Final change for Norwich, as Kvistgaarden who has not had much service tonight, comes off for Schwartau.

Bouaddi sends a looping ball across the field to McAidoo, which he picks up on the edge of the box, but he is unable to get the ball under control to take his shot and it is cleared away as far as another City shirt.

The corner comes in to the centre of the box but is headed out by a City shirt.

It’s all slightly too little too late for Norwich.

They get another corner as Musaba tries to send a cross into the box from the right and it is blocked out.

It has been revealed that A free-kick for Norwich now as O’Reilly commits the foul 35 yards out. It goes in towards McConville at the back post, but Ait-Nouri heads it out for a Norwich corner.

In a recent development, mo Touré strays just offside on the edge of the box, as Musaba sends a lovely little ball over to find him on the turn and the forward slots it past Rulli. Celebrations don’t quite begin before the flag goes up but that is a shame for the visitors.

Norwich have managed to get more of a grip in this half, despite conceding two more goals, but they are still without a shot on goal as we approach the final 15 minutes.

Another round of changes for both sides.

Man City take off scorer of their third goal Allan to bring on Braithwaite.

Norwich replace Ben Slimane and Bruno Alves with Touré and McConville.

Samba again at the heart of the action, laying off the ball to McAidoo on the right for the winger to run into the box. His shot towards the far post is saved low by Grimshaw who spills it almost into the path of Lewis, but Norwich survive.

According to recent reports, lewis makes a run down the right-hand side and crosses into Samba on the edge of the box. He lays off to McAidoo, but his shot goes sailing over the bar.

A surprise to no one, it is chucking it down in Manchester.

Sources indicate that major cheers from the away end as Norwich get their first corner of the evening. It is lofted high and long to the back post, where it is headed away by Bouaddi. It bounces out to Musaba, who has just come on, and he strikes it from the top of the box on the half-volley.

Recent findings suggest that his shot cuts through a crowd in the box and has Rulli diving to his left, but it goes wide of the post. What an introduction that would have been!

Industry observers note that well all the stories from this match will be all about young Floyd Samba. Feel free to leave your best punny Samba/dance-related headlines in the comments section.

For Man City as you would expect it is all about game management from here on out.

Some more changes to report for Norwich as well, as Crnac is replaced by Musaba.

Wright is able to run in to space towards the edge of the box, but as has been their story all evening, his pass out to the wing is just not where it needs to be and their effort just breaks down.

In a recent development, what a way to score a second! A night to remember for Floyd Samba!

It has been revealed that norwich try and play out from the back but far too sloppy and Ait-Nouri picks up the ball on the left of the box. He has plenty of time to tee up Samba inside the box at the left corner, who finds himself with plenty of space to curl his shot into the far corner, beating the diving Grimshaw.

We may be seeing plenty more of him this season.

According to recent reports, norwich looking for their way back into the game, as the ball comes down the left, fizzed in low and flashes past Rulli, trying to claim it. It deflects off a crowd of bodies and spins up, but Fisher can’t connect and it spins away harmlessly wide of the goal.

It is definitely Norwich’s best chance of the game and Fisher will be upset he hasn’t made more of that.

Industry observers note that and Allan makes it three! Minutes after the restart, the Brazilian makes his own mark on his debut.

In a recent development, maresca switched him onto the left side to escape Yongwa, and he picks up the ball outside the box and makes the run inside. He runs circles around Field and slots the ball home into the far bottom corner.

Industry observers note that some changes from both sides at half-time. McAidoo comes on for Cherki, though O’Reilly is the one to move up into midfield to fill the gap.

Norwich take off Diallo for Maghoma.

45 minutes left for the visitors to create something special!

What a moment for Floyd Samba! 😍A goal on his Man City debut for the 17-year-old, son of former Blackburn defender Chris 🩵 pic.twitter.com/VCVfX9HCNn.

Manchester City will be the ones to host Brighton in the next round – giving the visitors the opportunity to pull off a remarkable feat of knocking out both Manchester sides should they win.

Enjoy the highlights from last night as they came from behind to dispatch Man Utd:.

Possession: Man City 72% vs 28% Norwich.

Touches inside opposition box: 15 vs 1.

Industry observers note that and without much ado at the end of the half, we have reached the break. City put themselves in control with two quick-fire goals and it looks a tall task for Norwich to find their way back into the match.

Credit where it is due, Yongwa has been very good for Norwich. He has stood fast, made some very good challenges and stopped Allan getting much of a look-in on the right.

As we approach half-time, the stats tell a sorry story. Norwich have had just 28% possession and created a single shot, none on target.

As City come again, Norwich have pulled every man back to try and keep the situation salvageable before the break.

Samba was in again there, making a run into the box with a ball from Cherki, wrestling with Bruno Alves as he goes. The defender does enough to throw him off and Grimshaw is able to come out and snatch the ball.

Man City are looking to close this out now, and they look threatening every time they break.

Ait-Nouri is the latest to try his luck, making a run into the box from the left, but his shot is blocked.

A few minutes to remember here for Floyd Samba. First he steers home a very well taken header to give City the lead and then he plays a crucial role in the second, holding the ball up well before laying it off to Bouaddi to release Cherki to score. That’s how to make an impression on your debut.

And the floodgates have opened. Two goals in two minutes for the defending champions.

It has been revealed that samba finds Bouaddi in midfield, who takes it forward and feeds Cherki running to his left. He gets himself one-on-one and slots cool as you like into the bottom left corner.

City are in control all of a sudden and Norwich will be devastated.

As soon as I say that, Floyd Samba finds a way through.

He has looked the brightest for City, and O’Reilly sends a cross over the box from the left, drawing Grimshaw away from position. The ball is pinged back in by Allan and the youngster stoops to meet it, heading in to the bottom corner.

Norwich have been very disciplined in defence so far. Yongwa has been closing down Allan on the wing very well.

Cherki is starting to get some momentum – but is swarmed by yellow shirts as he picks up the ball on the edge of the area.

Industry observers note that another loose ball from City in midfield and Norwich pick it up again. The ball to set the front line free is equally as loose from the visitors though and it breaks down once again.

Sources indicate that samba is looking lively, racing to get on a ball in front of Darling just on the edge of the box. Darling recovers to send it out for a corner, which becomes a free kick after Ait-Nouri wrestles his man to the ground at the back post as City are taking.

Wright sends a long ball across the field, looking for a man on the right side but Rulli is alert to it and comes to claim at the edge of the box.

Kovacic demonstrates some promise with a strong run on the ball down the centre of the field, taking the ball all the way to the edge of the box, where he collides with a defender, and the ball spins away for Norwich to clear out.

This is better from City, who have looked like they’re lacking drive so far.

Sources indicate that yongwa again probing down the left side. It takes two to dispossess him and Man City manage to get the throw in, but approaching 20 minutes Norwich will be happy with this.

It has been revealed that kovacic loses the ball in midfield and Norwich surge forward. The move breaks down as Wright’s pass to Diallo on the wing is just behind him and he can’t take it forward into the box.

Spent the first 10 minutes trying to work out City’s system and settled on a 3-1-5-1, with Bouaddi operating as a nominal third centre-back, but it seems to have changed again now with O’Reilly dropping to left back and Bouaddi stepping into midfield. No doubt the metamorphosis will continue.

This Man City team have never played all together and it is clear that they’re still settling in here, figuring out how they’re going to press here.

Kovacic in the captain’s armband is tying it all together in midfield.

Khusanov threads a lovely ball to Samba who flicks it into the path of Lewis, who takes it and makes a run into the box. He creates space and sends a right-footed shot over the bar – but Man City are building.

According to recent reports, norwich make a move forward, with Yongwa bringing the ball down the left side but his cross into the box is blocked by Allan sliding in. The Brazilian is then fouled again as Yongwa tries to reclaim the ball and Man City get back in possession.

It’s actually three Samba brothers at City. The youngest, Emerson, is also in the academy.

Early foul on Allan gets Man City a free kick and they have started as everyone expected they would – in plenty of possession.

They look for the early goal as O’Reilly feeds him in the from the left side, but the shot is blocked.

We have kicked off in Manchester!

It’s nine changes for Norwich from the squad that lost 4-3 to Middlesbrough on the weekend.

Norwich goalkeeper Daniel Grimshaw came through the ranks at Manchester City, joining as a teenager, so this will be a special night for the 28-year-old.

Speaking of Phil Foden, the winger will not be making an appearance tonight, as he is serving his three-match suspension following his sending off in the Manchester derby. The England international lashed out at Bruno Fernandes after the United captain had fouled him, resulting in a red card for violent conduct.

As well as this fixture, he will also be missing City’s game against Sunderland and the trip to Anfield to face Liverpool the following weekend.

We broke down the incident as it happened on Sunday and you can get the full story here.

Heavy squad rotation (10 changes in total for Maresca) has handed debuts for Gero Rulli in goal, as well as Allan and Floyd Samba in the outfield.

17-year-old Samba is the latest from City’s academy to be making his debut in the senior squad, following in the footsteps of Phil Foden, Rico Lewis, Nico O’Reilly and many more. A versatile midfielder, he has totalled 24 appearances across six competitions (incl Premier League 2) and scored 17 and assisted six goals in those matches.

According to recent reports, keep your eyes on young midfielder Floyd Samba, who has been handed his Manchester City debut tonight against Norwich by manager Enzo Maresca. Floyd is the 17 year old son of former Blackburn Rovers defender Christopher Samba.

According to recent reports, his older brother Tyrone, 18, also plays for City. The siblings played in City’s FA Youth Cup final win over Manchester United last season, with Floyd scoring the first in a 2-1 win.

According to recent reports, city fans will also be keen to see how Allan Elias gets on on his first start, having arrived from Palmeiras for £34m. Geronimo Rulli also debuts in goal.

Good evening and welcome to another night of Carabao Cup coverage! It is the final fixture of round three (I promise) as Manchester City host Norwich.

These two sides have not met since 2022, when Norwich were still in the top flight and were beaten 4-0 by City. Looking at their previous meetings, the odds are definitely stacked in favour of Enzo Maresca’s side, who have scored 14 unanswered goals in their last three meetings with Norwich, while the Championship side have not scored any.

City will be looking to make it six straight wins across all competitions tonight, having started perfectly in the Premier League with four wins from four, and comfortably seeing off Porto in their Champions League opener.

They were the talk of the weekend with their deeply controversial 1-0 win over rivals Manchester United as – having gone down to 10 men after Phil Foden was sent off – their winning goal was allowed to stand despite Enzo Fernández being clearly in an offside position that impacted United’s keeper and backline.

Erling Haaland has put Manchester City ahead in the derby after a VAR check ⚽️ pic.twitter.com/V0DCwryhFy.

City are defending their title in this competition – beating Arsenal last year in the final – but like all Premier League teams playing in European competitions, have only entered the tournament this year in the third round.

Philippe Clement’s side beat MK Dons 4-1 in the first round, and followed that up with a 2-1 win over Cardiff City in the second to reach the Etihad tonight. The fourth-round draw has already been done, and it has been decided that the winner of this match will face Brighton.

But we have at least 90 minutes of the third round left before that, so without further ado, we’ll get underway and bring you team updates shortly!

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, potrebbe essere una giornata significativa per il futuro della Sambenedettese. A San Benedetto del Tronto è previsto un incontro tra il presidente rossoblù Vittorio Massi e Luca Gallo, ex patron della Reggina, interessato a rilevare il club marchigiano. Un appuntamento che potrebbe rappresentare il primo vero confronto tra le parti dopo i contatti avviati nelle scorse settimane dall'imprenditore romano con Luca Gualazzini, legale della società.

Come riportato dal Corriere Adriatico, il faccia a faccia servirà a capire se ci siano le condizioni per trasformare l'interesse manifestato finora in una trattativa concreta. Il nodo principale sarà rappresentato dagli aspetti economici, con particolare attenzione alle eventuali esposizioni debitorie, al disavanzo previsto tra entrate e uscite fino al termine della stagione e alle risorse necessarie per affrontare il mercato di gennaio.

In a recent development, L'intenzione di Gallo sarebbe quella di acquisire le quote di maggioranza della Sambenedettese, potendo contare anche sul coinvolgimento di altri imprenditori romani interessati a sostenere il progetto. Massi potrebbe invece conservare un ruolo all'interno della società attraverso una partecipazione di minoranza.

Non sarebbe esclusa neppure la permanenza dell'attuale presidente rossoblù, così come un eventuale coinvolgimento di imprenditori locali. Se le richieste economiche e le disponibilità del gruppo interessato dovessero trovare un punto d'incontro, l'operazione potrebbe svilupparsi anche in tempi relativamente rapidi.

According to recent reports, parallelamente, resta da monitorare un'altra ipotesi. Ci sarebbe infatti un imprenditore siciliano interessato alla Sambenedettese, che avrebbe affidato a Sandro Pochesci, ex allenatore dell'Aquila, il compito di avviare i contatti con Massi. Una pista sulla quale si starebbe lavorando già da alcune settimane e che potrebbe affiancarsi ad altre eventuali manifestazioni di interesse.

Il confronto tra Massi e Gallo potrebbe dunque rappresentare un passaggio importante per delineare gli scenari societari della Sambenedettese e capire se il futuro del club rossoblù sia destinato a cambiare proprietà.

Notts County vs Stevenage - prediction, team news, lineups
